rolling-waivers.title: Rolling waiver priority
rolling-waivers.pitch: Use a claim, go to the back of the line. Right now the order resets every week by record.
rolling-waivers.new_label: Rolling: whoever claims moves to last

faab.title: Blind bidding (FAAB)
faab.pitch: Every team gets a $100 budget for the season and bids on free agents. Highest bid wins; no more waiver-order luck.

weekly-add-cap.title: Cap pickups at 5 per week
weekly-add-cap.pitch: Five adds per matchup week, max. Stops the streaming arms race.

pass-td-6.title: 6-point passing touchdowns
pass-td-6.pitch: A TD pass is worth 6 instead of 4, same as a rushing or receiving TD. Quarterbacks matter more.

half-ppr.title: Half-point PPR
half-ppr.pitch: Catches worth 0.5 instead of 1. Pulls running backs back level with slot receivers.

harder-veto.title: Harder to veto trades
harder-veto.pitch: A trade gets blocked only if 6 teams vote against it, not 4. Fewer hostage situations.
